#include <stdint.h>

#include "api/dataflow/dataflow_api.h"

// Common arguments: w address, a address, w_pages, kt, nt, ntot, per_group, w_nk, mt, kc, a_pages, groups.
// Per-core arguments: core index.
void kernel_main() {
    constexpr auto w_args = TensorAccessorArgs<0>();
    constexpr auto a_args = TensorAccessorArgs<w_args.next_compile_time_args_offset()>();
    constexpr uint32_t cb_w = 1, cb_a = 0;
    const uint32_t w_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t a_addr = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(1);
    const uint32_t w_pages = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(2);
    const uint32_t kt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(3);
    const uint32_t nt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(4);
    const uint32_t ntot = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(5);
    const uint32_t per_group = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(6);
    const uint32_t w_nk = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(7);
    const uint32_t mt = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(8);
    const uint32_t kc = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(9);
    const uint32_t a_pages = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(10);
    const uint32_t groups = get_common_arg_val<uint32_t>(11);
    const uint32_t core = get_arg_val<uint32_t>(0);
    const uint32_t n0 = (core / per_group) * nt;
    const uint32_t cols = nt < (ntot - n0) ? nt : ntot - n0;
    const uint32_t place = core % per_group;
    const uint32_t m0 = (mt * place) / per_group;
    const uint32_t rows = ((mt * (place + 1)) / per_group) - m0;
    const auto w = TensorAccessor(w_args, w_addr, 2048);
    const auto a = TensorAccessor(a_args, a_addr, 2048);
    if (core >= groups * per_group) {
        return;
    }
    cb_reserve_back(cb_w, w_pages);
    const uint32_t w_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_w);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < kt; ++k) {
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
            const uint32_t n = n0 + j;
            noc_async_read_page(w_nk != 0 ? (n * kt) + k : (k * ntot) + n, w, w_ptr + ((k * cols) + j) * 2048);
        }
    }
    noc_async_read_barrier();
    cb_push_back(cb_w, w_pages);
    for (uint32_t m = 0; m < rows; ++m) {
        for (uint32_t k0 = 0; k0 < kt; k0 += kc) {
            const uint32_t count = (kt - k0) < kc ? kt - k0 : kc;
            cb_reserve_back(cb_a, a_pages);
            const uint32_t a_ptr = get_write_ptr(cb_a);
            for (uint32_t k2 = 0; k2 < count; ++k2) {
                noc_async_read_page(((m0 + m) * kt) + k0 + k2, a, a_ptr + k2 * 2048);
            }
            noc_async_read_barrier();
            cb_push_back(cb_a, a_pages);
        }
    }
}
